**PJB** is the original OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 with Pawel Jarczak's Bambu network-plugin bridge added, so Bambu cloud printers keep working. On Windows the plugin runs inside a bundled WSL2 runtime; on Linux it runs natively. We plan to rebuild it for every official OrcaSlicer release to stay in sync with upstream.

## What's new
- **Windows:** the installer now includes the complete WSL2 runtime, and installing a new version refreshes the old one automatically. Before, upgrading kept using the previous bridge, which caused the `Connection Failed [1:403]` camera error and failed print jobs with cloud-connected printers.
- **Windows:** the camera now works out of the box. The matching video player is downloaded together with the Bambu network plugin, so you no longer get the "media player component missing" error.
- **Windows:** a first-time install offers to set up the WSL2 runtime on first launch.
- **All platforms:** the splash screen and About dialog show the release, for example `2.4.2-PJB.2`.

## Known issues
- **Windows:** the first launch after a fresh install or an upgrade sets up the WSL2 runtime again, which can take several minutes (slower on virtual machines). A PowerShell window shows progress, and Orca may look unresponsive until it finishes.

| Windows | `OrcaSlicer_Windows_Installer_V2.4.2_x64.exe` (installer) or `OrcaSlicer_Windows_V2.4.2_portable.zip` |
